scoring_justification: The checker recomputes the four headline energy differences from the agent's submitted total energies (raw artifact) and compares each to the paper's reported value within tolerant thresholds; additionally a structural consistency check ensures the correlated formation energy is lower than HF, confirming correlation stabilization.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for the four derived energy quantities (formation energy, pseudorotation barrier, inversion barrier, reaction energy) used as gold targets
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2 and section 4.2 of the source paper, specifically the reported values in kcal/mol
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's text and table; formation energy gold uses the consistent comparison via supermolecule at 200 au as per eq. (7).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual computational results reported by the original authors for the same quantities.

outputs.description: Total energies for all species (HF and correlated) and derived reaction energies/barriers. The checker recomputes the four headline quantities from 'total_energies' and compares each to a paper-reported reference within a hidden tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The agent should use the basis set and geometries provided in the instruction. The correlated method can be MP2 or CCSD; scoring tolerances account for the method difference from the original PNO-CI/CEPA calculations.
